title: WhatsApp Automation for Real Estate: Set Up Instant Lead Follow-Up
seoTitle: WhatsApp Automation for Real Estate Leads: Setup Guide
excerpt: Set up WhatsApp automation for real estate: instant replies, buyer qualification, site visit reminders, routing, Meta's message costs and opt-in rules.
imageAlt: A young man reading a message on his smartphone at home

inlineImages.alt: A man on a desk phone talking while a colleague listens in an office

faqs.question: What is WhatsApp automation for real estate?
faqs.answer: It is a setup where every new property enquiry gets an instant WhatsApp reply with the brochure and a question, the buyer answers qualifying questions with buttons, hot leads go to a salesperson, and visit confirmations, reminders and follow-ups are sent automatically through approved templates.

faqs.question: Can I automate WhatsApp with the free WhatsApp Business app?
faqs.answer: Only partly. The free app offers greeting and away messages, quick replies and labels. Instant replies to ad and website leads, chatbot questions, routing, reminders and CRM sync need the WhatsApp Business Platform (API), through Meta's Cloud API or a solution provider.

faqs.question: Why do real estate leads go cold?
faqs.answer: Mostly because of slow follow-up, not bad ads: late replies after office hours, a single call attempt, leads scattered across portals, forms and phones, buyers ignoring unknown numbers, and first messages that give no useful information or easy question to answer.

faqs.question: Do I need approved templates for WhatsApp messages to leads?
faqs.answer: Yes, for any message sent outside the 24-hour customer service window that opens when a buyer messages you. That covers most first messages to form leads, reminders and follow-ups. Meta reviews each template and assigns it a marketing, utility or authentication category.

faqs.question: How much does WhatsApp automation cost for real estate?
faqs.answer: Meta charges per delivered message by category and country, and messages from buyers are free. Each number gets 1,000 free service messages a month; from 1 October 2026 service messages beyond that are charged. Your provider or developer charges separately for the platform and setup.

faqs.question: How should leads be routed to sales and channel partners?
faqs.answer: Agree the rules before automating: by project, location or rotation. Record when each lead arrived and was assigned, tag CP-sourced leads to that CP, send returning buyers to their previous salesperson, and reassign leads that are not picked up within a set time.

faqs.question: Can I message leads who didn't ask to be contacted?
faqs.answer: No. Meta's opt-in rules require that the person gave you their number and agreed to receive messages from your named business. Bought lists don't qualify, and blocks and reports from cold messages lower your quality and can restrict your messaging limits.

faqs.question: What should I measure after automating WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Time to first reply, the share of leads answering the first question, site visits booked and completed, leads with no human contact after 24 hours (aim for zero), and cost per site visit by lead source once visits are linked to the original ad.
